environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: None configured
**Cloud provider(s)**: None configured
**Repository visibility**: varies per repo — confirm with gh for the specific repo rather than assuming either way

**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured. Never publish or upload anything to a public destination — gists, pastebins, third-party paste services, or Claude Artifacts. There is no sanctioned external destination for this user's content.

**Secrets management**: No managed secret store. Homelab secrets are generated on the box (`openssl rand -hex 32`) and never leave it — never pasted into chat or a transcript, never committed. macOS Keychain holds local credentials. Off-box backup copies are kept because host snapshots roll back the whole machine.
**Default / protected branches**: None configured
**CI/CD deploy targets**: None configured
**Network posture**: None configured
**Source control**: github.com/mrtysn — code from repos outside this account is external and is not to be cloned and executed without the user saying so
**Trusted internal domains**: mertyas.in and its subdomains — self-hosted personal services
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured
**Key internal services**: self-hosted apps on mertyas.in subdomains, served from the node01 homelab box
**Internal package registry**: None configured

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: never commit or publish anything naming a third party (CVs, interview notes, candidate assessments), ex-employer material, or credentials — a repo being private does not make these safe to commit

**Data retention / declassification**: some repos are local-by-default and publish only an explicitly promoted subdirectory — read the repo's own CLAUDE.md for its rule, and never bypass .gitignore with git add -f
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries prod or production as a whole word or name segment
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries prod or production as a whole word or name segment
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: personal work — own software projects, self-hosted infrastructure, research and writing. No employer work on this machine.
**Trusted repo**: the repo the session started in, and its origin remote under github.com/mrtysn. Other repos on disk are out of scope unless the user names them.
**Org-specific CLIs**: None configured

**Routine promotion**: in repos that are local-by-default, moving a file into the repo's tracked or published directory is the documented, deliberate publication step — treat it as routine rather than as accidental exposure, subject to the never-promote exclusions above
